claims.object_text: ictal vocalizations exhibited by Scn1a+/- mice
claims.quote: Our study shows that ictal vocalizations are exhibited by Scn1a+/- mice.

claims.object_text: increased total vocalizations during spontaneous GTCS
claims.quote: Spontaneous GTCS in Scn1a+/- mice were associated with a significantly higher number of total vocalizations.

claims.object_text: increased audible mouse squeaks with GTCS
claims.quote: The number of audible mouse squeaks was significantly greater with GTCS activity.

claims.object_text: ultrasonic vocalizations present in 98% seizure clips vs 57% nonseizure
claims.quote: Nearly all (98%) the seizure clips contained ultrasonic vocalizations, whereas ultrasonic vocalizations were present in only 57% of nonseizure clips.

claims.object_text: ultrasonic vocalizations higher frequency and nearly twice as long in seizure vs nonseizure
claims.quote: The ultrasonic vocalizations emitted in the seizure clips were at a significantly higher frequency and were nearly twice as long in duration as those emitted in the nonseizure clips.

claims.object_text: audible mouse squeaks primarily emitted during preictal phase
claims.quote: Audible mouse squeaks were primarily emitted during the preictal phase.

claims.object_text: greatest number of ultrasonic vocalizations during ictal phase
claims.quote: The greatest number of ultrasonic vocalizations was detected during the ictal phase.
